theme_strategy.philosophy: Apple Minimalist Real Estate (Jony Ive / Alan Dye precision meets Swiss typography). Pure clarity, serene whites, refined neutrals, and surgical contrast. Retires all gratuitous gold/yellow (#F5A623) accents and dark muddy gradients in favor of Apple Action Blue (#0066CC / #0071E3), deep Apple Ink (#1D1D1F), warm aluminum tinting (#F5F5F7), and calm photography with breathable negative space.

color_palette.mode: Light Apple Human Interface (high clarity, calm, compliant)

retirement_of_gold.verdict: RETIRE completely from primary CTAs, text highlights, and borders. Apple does not use high-saturation amber/gold for core interactions. The previous #F5A623 felt like a discount sales banner. Replace all primary action buttons with Apple Solid Navy (#0F2A5B) or Apple Action Blue (#0066CC) pill buttons. For out-of-area referral flags, use refined subtle slate/navy chips instead of loud gold/brass outlines.

components.name: CommunityCardGrid

Subtle lift on hover (-translate-y-1, box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)), arrow icon transitions into view.

page_2_city_town_detail.design_goal: Transform the previously dense, emoji-heavy, dark gradient city page into a serene, factual, Apple-grade editorial document.

sections_order_and_treatments.treatment: Clean, understated horizontal trail with Lucide ChevronRight (size 13). Font size 13px, color #86868B, active page #1D1D1F font-medium. Uses Breadcrumbs.jsx with schema.org BreadcrumbList.

REPLACE the harsh dark navy photo box with an Apple dual-zone hero: A high-key, airy panoramic region photography card with 22px border radius, subtle scrim, and floating frosted glass info chip OR clean light parchment container (#F5F5F7). Region kicker in uppercase tracking-[0.14em]. H1 '{community}, BC' in SF Pro Display (font-bold text-4xl sm:text-5xl).
sections_order_and_treatments.stat_strip_refinement: Transform the old cramped box into a 4-column Apple Metric Bar: Each metric has an uppercase micro-label in #86868B (11px, tracking-[0.08em]), followed by a massive, crisp number in SF Pro Bold (text-2xl sm:text-3xl #1D1D1F). The fourth item 'DATA SOURCE' replaces the green emoji dot with an elegant Lucide CheckCircle2 in #248A3D accompanied by 'CREA DDF® Live Verified'.
sections_order_and_treatments.primary_cta: Replace gold pill with Apple Solid Navy (#0F2A5B) pill button: 'View {active} listings' with Lucide ArrowUpRight icon.

sections_order_and_treatments.treatment: Differentiate in-area vs out-of-area without loud yellow. In-area (Doug LeMaire direct representation): crisp 48px round portrait, white background card, subtle hairline border, 'Doug LeMaire, REALTOR® · Covers {community} directly · BCFSA Licence #167790'. Out-of-area: Doogie concierge illustration in a dedicated frosted pill card with clean copy and an understated blue-link CTA 'Request vetted introduction →'.

Apple Callout Style: Crisp white card with soft left accent bar (3px solid #0066CC) or subtle blue tint (#F5F8FF), rounded-[18px], p-6. Heading 'At a Glance' with Lucide Sparkles or Info icon. Maximum 60-word concise synopsis for AI search grounding and fast scanning.

Subtle italicized meta stamp: 'Last reviewed: March 2026 · Sourced from public records'. Followed by glossary prose where real estate terms (PTT, ALR, Form B) have clean underline tags that reveal definition tooltips on hover.

Two-column 50/50 layout on desktop. Left: interactive map iframe nested in a 20px rounded frame with hairline border. Right: Scrollable grid of sub-neighbourhood cards. REVISE icons: replace 🤝 and 📍 with Lucide MapPin and ArrowRight. Live inventory chips display subtle badges '12 listings · $1.2M median'. Referral neighbourhoods display a quiet 'Referral network' chip in #0F2A5B/0.08.

Apple Product Grid: 4 cards with 16:10 photography, 18px rounded corners, crisp white background, border 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06). Virtual tour tag becomes a frosted glass pill 'Virtual Tour' with Lucide Video. Price in bold SF Pro Display, followed by Bed/Bath/SqFt stats separated by middle dots (·) and address in muted secondary text.

Typography-first layout: 68ch maximum reading width, font-size 17px, line-height 1.65. Climate section uses an Apple Weather style card (#FBFBFD) with Lucide CloudSun or Thermometer icon, citing Environment and Climate Change Canada with an official source link.

REPLACE raw look with an Apple Settings-style table: Clean 3-row card (Municipal boundary, Agricultural Land Reserve [ALR], Mapped floodplain). Each row features a title, a crisp status badge (Yes / No / Centroid Intersect), and subtle disclaimer text. Footer notes DataBC OpenMaps WFS attribution.

REPLACE the raw JSON <pre> dump! Render an Apple Health/Stats key-value grid or 4-tile demographic summary: Population, Median Age, Household Size, Dwelling Types. Clean numbers in SF Pro Bold with source badge 'Statistics Canada 2021 Census'.

Use Radix / Shadcn Accordion styled with Apple elegance: white surface, subtle horizontal separator line (1px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)), no heavy border frames. Chevron rotates smoothly. Font-medium question, 15px muted answer.

In-area: Rich deep navy card (#0F2A5B) with white text, providing twin Apple pill buttons: 'I'm Buying in {community}' (White pill, navy text) and 'I'm Selling in {community}' (Translucent glass pill). Out-of-area: Calm light stone card (#F5F5F7) featuring Doogie concierge, factual explanation of BC referral network, and single navy CTA button.
Pill chips of adjacent communities with Lucide ArrowRight. Strictly factual BCFSA, CREA DDF®, and PIPA compliance disclaimer in 12px neutral text with appropriate trademark credits.

viewport_rules: Stack all 2-column spatial context grids to 1-column on screens below 768px.
The 4-metric market stat strip converts into a 2x2 clean metric grid with hairline dividers on mobile, ensuring no horizontal overflow.
Breadcrumbs allow horizontal gentle wrap with text-[12px] to fit 390px iPhone width (e.g. iPhone 13/14/15/16 Pro).
Sub-neighbourhood cards expand to full-width or 2-column compact pills (padding 10px 14px) with minimum 44px tap targets.
Listing photo aspect-ratio stays locked to 16:10 with lazy loading.
Action buttons must be full width on mobile or stacked with 10px vertical gap.

bcfsa_crea_guidelines: Copy must remain 100% factual. DO NOT add marketing superlatives ('best neighbourhood', 'ultimate luxury', 'top performing market').
In-area communities must state: 'Doug LeMaire, REALTOR® · Fraser Property Management Realty Services Ltd. · BCFSA Licence #167790'.

Out-of-area communities must state: 'This community is outside Doug LeMaire\'s direct service area. A vetted introduction to a BCFSA-licensed local REALTOR® is available at $0 cost to the consumer. Consumer approves each introduction.'
All MLS® listing cards and counts must attribute: 'MLS® data sourced from CREA DDF® (Data Distribution Facility). REALTOR®, REALTORS® and MLS® are trademarks of CREA.'
Climate statistics must attribute: 'Environment and Climate Change Canada / Open-Meteo 30-year climate normals.'
All interactive buttons and links must maintain explicit data-testid attributes for test automation.

rules: Do NOT use dark gradients as page backgrounds. Apple designs are characterized by pristine light canvas with high-contrast content.
Retire all occurrences of gold (#F5A623) accents. Replace with Apple Action Blue (#0066CC) or Deep Navy (#0F2A5B).
Replace emoji icons (🏡, 🐾, 🤝, 🎥, 🟢, 📍) with SVG icons from lucide-react.
Format demographic data into high-density clean cards; never render unformatted JSON strings.
Ensure all containers with borders have p-6 or p-8 padding so typography never touches borders.
Implement responsive classes mobile-first, ensuring flawless 390px iPhone mobile layout.
Include data-testid on every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, accordion triggers, cards).
All files are in React .js / .jsx (not .tsx) with Tailwind CSS classes and existing homeNext.css classes where appropriate.
